controls.title: 3D controls and active play
controls.setup: Use a safe outdoor area with several nearby creatures or objects, a short practice jump, and enough health/stamina. Keep movement and targeting defaults for the demonstration. Record short clips with key presses visible.

gear.title: Equipment, inventory and spells
gear.setup: Use a character with two gear choices, stackable supplies, an Ust, two expendable salvage materials, a usable spellbook/caster, and a vendor nearby. Save valuables outside the salvage batch.

world.title: World, party and character states
world.setup: Group location-dependent work together: a party member for trade/party, an owned or permitted house, an active contract, an outdoor death location when convenient, and your server’s barber service. These shots can wait until the relevant state occurs naturally.

setup.title: Launcher, setup and UI stills
setup.setup: Use sample server/account names. Hide passwords and personal paths. Choose a comfortable UI/text scale; frame the relevant panel closely enough that its controls are readable.

terminal.title: TUI gameplay and scripts
terminal.setup: Use a real terminal session with a prepared character and the shipped scripts. Show pane focus and the footer; choose a large enough terminal font for the final website size. All interactive TUI capture belongs to the user.

summon-leash.setup: An active player summon beside its owner.
summon-leash.framing: Show the player, summon, complete glowing leash and readable summon name.
summon-leash.expected: A green leash identifies the local player's summon, with its name using the player palette.

smart-tab.setup: Several eligible targets; show peace/combat stance and targeting preferences.
smart-tab.framing: Keep the target HUD, a few candidates and the key display in frame.
smart-tab.expected: A hold acquires a target; taps and Shift+Tab cycle; interaction/attack is a separate deliberate action.

jump-demo.setup: A repeatable, safe short jump with the landing visible.
jump-demo.framing: Show the character, target, trajectory and power bar together.
jump-demo.expected: The chosen preview and executed landing are visible in one continuous clip.

camera.setup: Open ground with a landmark to compare character facing.
camera.framing: Keep the character and landmark visible; label mouse buttons.
camera.expected: Orbit leaves facing alone; right-hold steers, and middle/both buttons move forward.

loadouts.setup: Two weapon/gear arrangements, with one slot intentionally omitted and an empty included slot.
loadouts.framing: Crop the builder and destination bar. Stop once the preset is saved; do not demonstrate gear changes.
loadouts.expected: The reader can create and save a loadout; prose explains what applying it changes.

spells.setup: Known spells in several schools/levels and an empty spell-bar cell.
spells.framing: Keep the spell search, filters and destination bar readable, then close the spellbook before casting. The final framing must include the character and cast effect.
spells.expected: A spell is found, inspected and bound, then cast with the book closed so the animation and result are visible.

hud.setup: Unlock UI layout in a real gameplay scene.
hud.framing: Crop one HUD component with its actual move and resize handles visible; omit unrelated windows.
hud.expected: The component’s layout-editing affordances are clear at guide size.

launcher.setup: A sample server/profile with account filled and password hidden.
launcher.framing: Frame server/profile choices, account and Play; omit private machine details.
launcher.expected: Readers can identify each step used by the connection guide.

content-picker.setup: A launcher server using an actual retail DAT folder.
content-picker.framing: Crop the content-folder field and Browse/Use application default controls. Native OS file-picker chrome is outside this capture.
content-picker.expected: The reader can locate the application’s folder selection control and see a selected DAT folder.

tui-workflow.setup: A focused dashboard with an assessed entity and context pane.
tui-workflow.framing: Keep pane boundaries, focus and footer shortcuts legible.
tui-workflow.expected: The reader recognizes the dashboard, context and input areas.

combat-controls.setup: A melee weapon equipped in combat stance.
combat-controls.framing: Crop the curved HUD with power, height and start/stop controls.
combat-controls.expected: The unfamiliar layout and its controls are recognizable.

locks.setup: A real locked chest/door, at least one key, trained Lockpick and a usable pick.
locks.framing: Keep the locked entity and the unlock helper in frame together, with the viewport feedback animation visible.
locks.expected: The reader sees the key/lockpick actions and their success or failure overlay on the actual target.

salvage.setup: Two expendable materials, including a stack; prepare but do not submit the batch.
salvage.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Close view of Items to salvage and Estimated output; retain all quantities.
salvage.expected: Whole-stack inclusion and separate material output rows are visible.

vendor.setup: One purchase and one sale queued at a vendor.
vendor.framing: Crop the vendor window with stock, both queued items and the balance.
vendor.expected: The reader recognizes the reviewed exchange and Trade button.

player-trade.setup: A consenting second player with a small sample offer on each side.
player-trade.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Frame the whole trade window with both participants and confirmation/reset controls.
player-trade.expected: Both offers and acceptance states are readable; no valuable exchange is required.

character-progression.setup: A character sheet with a trainable skill and an affordable improvement quote; do not buy unintentionally.
character-progression.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show the skill and cost, with a second still for the Train confirmation.
character-progression.expected: Immediate improvement cost and separately confirmed training are distinguishable.

waypoints.setup: A waypoint set on the world map.
waypoints.framing: Crop the destination pin and enough map labels to orient it.
waypoints.expected: The reader recognizes a marked destination.

housing-payments.setup: A house crystal with a real purchase/maintenance requirement and suitable carried items.
housing-payments.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show eligibility/payment rows and Auto-fill; stop before payment unless desired.
housing-payments.expected: Prepared amounts and remaining requirements are readable.

journal.setup: An in-progress or repeatable contract with a contact/quest location.
journal.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show filtered contract details, a timer and its map destination; use two stills if needed.
journal.expected: Progress/timing and the useful destination are clear.

corpse-recovery.setup: A real saved outdoor death location shown by /corpse.
corpse-recovery.framing: Crop the chat output and clickable coordinates.
corpse-recovery.expected: The reader can locate the saved death coordinates; prose explains setting a waypoint.

party.setup: A small party with a leader and another visible member.
party.framing: Show the roster/recruitment controls and party HUD together at a readable scale.
party.expected: The leader, membership and selected member can be identified.

chat.setup: Inactive chat with its history activation button visible.
chat.framing: Close up on the activation icon and a little surrounding chat.
chat.expected: The reader can locate the control that makes chat accept pointer input.

emotes.framing: Crop the wheel with its choices and recent emotes.
emotes.expected: The reader can recognize and choose from the wheel.

barber.setup: Your server’s barber interaction, with heritage-specific choices available.
barber.framing: Crop Barbershop with appearance choices and Apply/Cancel.
barber.expected: The choices and explicit Apply action are clear; applying is optional.

tui-gameplay.setup: A real inventory Split quantity prompt for a carried stack.
tui-gameplay.framing: Show the prompt with relevant item and footer actions.
tui-gameplay.expected: The reader recognizes how a multi-step inventory task is presented.

item-appraisal.setup: An ordinary item with requirements, effects and effective combat values.
item-appraisal.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Crop the appraisal window with title and relevant fields; no test errors or missing artwork.
item-appraisal.expected: A reader can find requirements and effective values at website size.

inventory-merge.setup: An inventory pack-strip or bag-header context menu open.
inventory-merge.framing: Crop the bag control and popup, with Auto-merge readable.
inventory-merge.expected: The reader can find the Auto-merge action.

action-bars.setup: A filled action bar with its menu expanded.
action-bars.framing: Frame just the bar and popup; all four menu actions are readable.
action-bars.expected: The reader can locate Clear, Cycle, Clone and Delete.

character-creation.setup: A new character draft on the Race page.
character-creation.framing: Capture the creation page and preview, omitting unrelated application chrome.
character-creation.expected: The reader recognizes the race choices and character preview.

hardware-info.setup: Launcher App settings open to graphics; machine details safe to show.
hardware-info.framing: Crop the relevant controls and Copy hardware info, without dumping the full report into the image.
hardware-info.expected: The troubleshooting action is easy to locate.

minimap.setup: Outdoor minimap with useful terrain, buildings and impassable zones.
minimap.framing: Crop the minimap at a readable scale.
minimap.expected: The reader sees the terrain information available around them.

creature-appraisal.setup: A player appraisal with a loaded 3D model and useful character details.
creature-appraisal.framing: Crop the appraisal window; show the model and identity clearly.
creature-appraisal.expected: The reader recognizes the model preview; prose explains rotation and independent selection.

selected-hud.setup: A selected player with several available actions.
selected-hud.framing: Crop only the selected-entity HUD and its open menu; keep labels readable.
selected-hud.expected: Show a tight crop of the selected name, health bar, magnifying glass and open actions menu.

chat-completion.setup: Chat input with a partial command and multiple suggestions.
chat-completion.framing: Crop to the composer and suggestions. Show syntax and descriptions, then accept a suggestion.
chat-completion.expected: Type a partial command, browse suggestions and accept one. Keep the input and suggestion list in frame.

chat-links.setup: A coordinate message and a real entity alert in the same chat buffer.
chat-links.framing: Crop to the two linked messages and the history-interaction control.
chat-links.expected: Show coordinate and entity-alert links in the chat buffer with history interaction enabled.

nearby-list.setup: Several nearby creatures or objects with distinguishable names.
nearby-list.framing: Crop the Nearby panel with an active search and a short result list.
nearby-list.expected: Show the Nearby name search, useful filters and matching results.

treestats-import.setup: Open Import from TreeStats with a recognizable public server search.
treestats-import.framing: Crop the import dialog; retain search, software, population and the import control.
treestats-import.expected: Show the TreeStats search results, server software and import action.

profile-content.setup: The server editor with Advanced expanded.
profile-content.framing: Crop the server editor with Content path override, its browse button and Save visible.
profile-content.expected: Show the server content-folder override and the action that saves the change.

crafting-confirmation.setup: A trained Cooking skill, Flour and Water, with crafting-chance confirmation enabled.
crafting-confirmation.framing: Crop the real chance-confirmation dialog. Identify the attempted recipe in its caption or surrounding guide text.
crafting-confirmation.expected: The server-reported chance and explicit accept/decline controls are readable.

world-map-controls.setup: Open the World map with a recognizable location and its visibility controls.
world-map-controls.framing: Crop to the map panel; keep labels and layer controls readable.
world-map-controls.expected: Crop the World map with its visibility controls, a useful destination and pan/zoom context.

character-roster.setup: A character selected in a populated roster, with the equipped 3D preview visible.
character-roster.framing: Use the complete character-selection screen, including the roster, 3D character and scene backdrop.
character-roster.expected: The reader recognizes the full character-selection experience and can find Enter World and Create character.

inventory-overview.setup: Two populated packs with varied item names and types; equipment visible alongside contents.
inventory-overview.framing: Crop the inventory panel. Show both bag headings in the shared scroll view, jump using a pack icon, then cycle Native, Alphabetical and Item type sorting.
inventory-overview.expected: The reader understands that bags share a scrolling view and sorting reorganizes each bag visually without moving items.

equipment-strip.setup: A few equipped items, with the strip scrolled to its top and its toolbar visible.
equipment-strip.framing: Crop only the equipment strip: equipped slots, scroll controls and helmet/cloak/loadout toolbar. Exclude adjacent bag contents.
equipment-strip.expected: The reader recognizes the equipment slots and can locate the visibility and loadout controls.

inventory-split.setup: A carried stack with the split quantity dialog open.
inventory-split.framing: Crop the modal with item name, amount, slider and Split button.
inventory-split.expected: The quantity choice is clear without showing the whole inventory.

creation-appearance.setup: The same draft on the Appearance page.
creation-appearance.framing: Keep the preview and appearance choices visible.
creation-appearance.expected: The reader recognizes the appearance controls and clothing reroll.

creation-build.setup: The same draft with attributes and skills allocated.
creation-build.framing: Show the combined attributes, starting vitals and skill groups.
creation-build.expected: The reader sees the build together in one place.

creation-review.setup: The same draft on the final Review page.
creation-review.framing: Show the final build, starting town and Create character action.
creation-review.expected: The reader can recognize the final review before creation.

combat-controls-missile.setup: A bow equipped with ammunition, in combat stance.
combat-controls-missile.framing: Crop the curved HUD with accuracy, height and ammunition.
combat-controls-missile.expected: The reader recognizes the missile variation and ammunition display.

minimap-dungeon.setup: A dungeon minimap after walking a winding route.
minimap-dungeon.framing: Crop the minimap with passages and breadcrumb trail visible.
minimap-dungeon.expected: The reader can distinguish the passage layout and their recent route.

waypoint-minimap.setup: The same waypoint visible on the minimap.
waypoint-minimap.framing: Crop the minimap with direction and distance visible.
waypoint-minimap.expected: The reader recognizes the guidance toward the destination.

run-casting.setup: A caster, usable spell and safe route with room to run.
run-casting.framing: Keep the running character and cast animation visible. Spellbook and unrelated windows closed; agree framing with the user.
run-casting.expected: The character continues moving throughout the windup and the completed spell is visible.

enchantments.setup: Several real active effects with readable remaining durations.
enchantments.framing: Crop only the populated Enchantments window; wait for all visible spell icons to load and show groups, remaining time and search/filter controls.
enchantments.expected: The reader recognizes the effect groups and can find durations and filtering controls.

hud-showcase.setup: Enable /ui-showcase in a real gameplay scene.
hud-showcase.framing: Full viewport with the HUD components visible and no layout controls.
hud-showcase.expected: Introduce the HUD and connect each component to its player guide.

spell-list.setup: Open the Spells tab with filters and one spell expanded.
spell-list.framing: Crop the full panel, keeping filters, details and Cast buttons visible.
spell-list.expected: Show spell discovery and direct casting from the list.

spell-bar.setup: Populate a spell tab with several spells.
spell-bar.framing: Crop the spell bar, including tab selectors and shortcut hints.
spell-bar.expected: Introduce the spell bar before explaining how to populate it.

action-bar-intro.setup: Populate an action bar and hover a targeted item shortcut.
action-bar-intro.framing: Crop the bar and tooltip, keeping the Shift-click alternate action readable.
action-bar-intro.expected: Introduce direct item shortcuts, default self-use and alternate targeting.

inventory-currencies.setup: Carry several alternate currencies and open the currency popup.
inventory-currencies.framing: Crop the inventory footer and readable alternate-currency totals.
inventory-currencies.expected: Show the currency summary across carried packs.

chat-overview.setup: Show the chat buffer with messages and its controls.
chat-overview.framing: Crop the full chat panel, including activation icon, filters and composer.
chat-overview.expected: Introduce the chat panel and identify its controls.

recall-menu.setup: Open Recall destinations on the world map.
recall-menu.framing: Crop the menu and its trigger with destination labels readable.
recall-menu.expected: Show the map’s recall destination menu.

party-hud.setup: Show the party HUD with a full roster.
party-hud.framing: Crop the teammate cards and vital bars.
party-hud.expected: Show the compact party HUD and its member vitals.

allegiance.setup: Open Social’s Allegiance tab with relationship details visible.
allegiance.framing: Crop the panel with membership, relationships and contributed XP readable.
allegiance.expected: Show allegiance relationships and membership details.

character-title.setup: Open the earned-title selector in Character → Progression.
character-title.framing: Crop the character header and expanded title list.
character-title.expected: Show how to choose an earned character title.

housing-map.setup: Enable a housing search overlay on the world map.
housing-map.framing: Show the map with house markers distributed across the results.
housing-map.expected: Show housing search results as a world-map overlay.

housing-management.setup: Open the Housing tab for an owned home with maintenance and property details expanded.
housing-management.framing: Crop the tab with access, decoration and advanced sections visible.
housing-management.expected: Introduce the house management controls and maintenance summary.

appearance-toggles.setup: Show helmet and cloak visibility controls in Inventory.
appearance-toggles.framing: Crop the controls beneath the equipment strip.
appearance-toggles.expected: Locate the helmet and cloak appearance toggles.

selection-outline.setup: Select or attack a creature in the world.
selection-outline.framing: Crop the creature and enough scene context to identify its indicator.
selection-outline.expected: Show the selected outline through an obstruction.

combat-reticle.setup: Select or attack a creature in the world.
combat-reticle.framing: Crop the creature and enough scene context to identify its indicator.
combat-reticle.expected: Show the reticle marking the active combat target.

nearby-button.framing: Crop the button with its minimap rim for orientation.
nearby-button.expected: Locate the control that opens the entity list and alerts.
